antipattern.code:
#!/bin/bash
# csrc/build_aclnn.sh - ACLNN 构建脚本

ROOT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)

# 每个 SOC 版本分支中重复的 catlass 依赖设置逻辑
build_for_soc() {
    local soc_version=$1

    case "${soc_version}" in
        "910A"|"910B")
            # catlass 依赖设置 - 重复逻辑
            catlass_commit=$(git config -f "${ROOT_DIR}/.gitmodules" \
                --get submodule.csrc/third_party/catlass.commit)
            catlass_path="${ROOT_DIR}/csrc/third_party/catlass"
            git submodule init "${catlass_path}"
            git submodule update "${catlass_path}"
            cd "${catlass_path}"
            git checkout "${catlass_commit}"
            absolute_catlass_path=$(cd "${catlass_path}" && pwd)
            export CPATH="${absolute_catlass_path}:${CPATH}"
            echo "Setting up catlass dependency..."
            ;;
        "910C")
            # 同样的 catlass 依赖设置 - 重复逻辑
            catlass_commit=$(git config -f "${ROOT_DIR}/.gitmodules" \
                --get submodule.csrc/third_party/catlass.commit)
            catlass_path="${ROOT_DIR}/csrc/third_party/catlass"
            git submodule init "${catlass_path}"
            git submodule update "${catlass_path}"
            cd "${catlass_path}"
            git checkout "${catlass_commit}"
            absolute_catlass_path=$(cd "${catlass_path}" && pwd)
            export CPATH="${absolute_catlass_path}:${CPATH}"
            echo "Setting up catlass dependency..."
            ;;
    esac
}

pattern.code:
#!/bin/bash
# csrc/build_aclnn.sh - ACLNN 构建脚本

ROOT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)

# 共享函数：集中管理 catlass 依赖设置逻辑
setup_catlass_dependency() {
    local catlass_commit
    catlass_commit=$(git config -f "${ROOT_DIR}/.gitmodules" \
        --get submodule.csrc/third_party/catlass.commit)
    local catlass_path="${ROOT_DIR}/csrc/third_party/catlass"

    git submodule init "${catlass_path}"
    git submodule update "${catlass_path}"
    cd "${catlass_path}"
    git checkout "${catlass_commit}"

    absolute_catlass_path=$(cd "${catlass_path}" && pwd) || {
        echo "Error: Failed to resolve absolute path for catlass" >&2
        exit 1
    }
    export CPATH="${absolute_catlass_path}${CPATH:+:${CPATH}}"
    log "Setting up catlass dependency..."
}

build_for_soc() {
    local soc_version=$1

    case "${soc_version}" in
        "910A"|"910B")
            setup_catlass_dependency
            ;;
        "910C")
            setup_catlass_dependency
            ;;
    esac
}
